description: Change an element. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. By kind: level {name, elevation, height}; wall {length, height, thickness}; slab {thickness}; roof {roofType flat|shed|gable|hip, pitch, overhang, thickness}; stair {width, going, maxRiser, shape straight|L|U, turn left|right, position, rotation}; door/window {width, height, open 0–1}; furniture {position, rotation, width, depth, height, lamp {on, lumens, kelvin}}; column {shape rect|round, width, depth, height, position, rotation}; room {name}. wall also {attachTop: true} to extend it up to the roof over it. Any: {name}. A size outside the element's limits fails with the allowed range unless clamp is true.
name: update_element
title: Update element
